kv12.10:1.4: Sattamabhaviko puggalo nirayaṃ upapajjeyya, tiracchānayoniṃ upapajjeyya, pittivisayaṃ upapajjeyyāti?
kv12.10:1.6: Tena hi sattamabhavikassa puggalassa pahīnā duggatīti.
kv12.10:2.1: Saṃvaro kammaṃ tath' eva asaṃvaro, Sabbaṃ kammaṃ savipākaṃ , Saddo vipāko, Saḷāyatanaṃ vipāko, Sattakkhattuparamo puggalo sattakkhattuparamatā niyato, Kolaṃkolo puggalo kolaṃkolatā niyato, Ekabījī puggalo ekabījitā niyato Diṭṭhisampanno puggalo sañcicca pāṇaṃ jīvitā voropeyya, Diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa pahīnā duggati, Tath' eva Sattamabhavikassāti. 1.
